parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECS instance.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup job.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- **UDM\_ECS**: ECS instance backup

- **UDM\_ECS\_DISK**: a disk backup subtask of an ECS instance backup

- **UDM\_DISK**: disk backup

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: UdmRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the ECS instance.
